name: QuietDesk
oneliner: A calm Android home screen with only the apps you choose.
summary: QuietDesk is a minimal Android launcher prototype. It replaces the home screen with a clock and a short list of favorite apps, with search for everything else.
description: Phones are loud by default. QuietDesk is an Android launcher that strips the home screen back to a clock and the handful of apps you pick as favorites. Everything else is one search away.
Settings cover 12 or 24 hour time and an optional seconds display. It is an unreleased prototype.
